2e3d0203-e1d2-4142-b6ab-69a70643d7a1.title: Class ga Isekai Shoukan sareta Naka Ore dake Nokotta n desu ga
2e3d0203-e1d2-4142-b6ab-69a70643d7a1.altTitle: My Entire Class was Summoned to Another World Except for Me
2e3d0203-e1d2-4142-b6ab-69a70643d7a1.description:
A god of a different world had abruptly appeared in Kamiya Yato's classroom and forcibly summoned the entire class to his world... except for him, because he was sleeping in a seat in the corner of the class, the round summoning magic circle didn't reach him, and he ended up staying here on Earth, but with brand-new skills.

After he made it through a whole year full of police interviews and journalism reports, he finally became a high school student, but the quiet days he had hoped for were far from over; be it terrorists who decide to occupy his school or even monsters from different world, one by one new incidents take place in the town he lives in...

Will a boy without any motivation be able to save the world?
___
Note: No raw updates since October 2021; assume hiatus by author. Comic Boost still lists the series as an "irregular serialization" rather than axed, so there remains a slim possibility for future updates.

9429ab78-c308-42ee-bcb6-9e6f0aa7b1fc.title: Bakuchi Gui
9429ab78-c308-42ee-bcb6-9e6f0aa7b1fc.description: Raised by an older brother who was a genius gambler and learned countless tricks of the trade, the man known as "Bull" knows every kind of cheat. However, he himself has never used any of them—he lives a regular life as a full-time office worker. Then one day, his brother goes missing. As Bull searches for him, he uncovers a clue: his brother has fallen into "the Swamp," a deadly gambling den where those consumed by greed end up. To save the kind brother he once knew—and to uncover his brother's hidden side—Bull steps into "the Swamp"!

ffeef500-d3e0-4c8d-b0f4-ce178afe7b87.title: Mada Kimi o Miageteru
ffeef500-d3e0-4c8d-b0f4-ce178afe7b87.altTitle: I'm Still Looking Up At You
ffeef500-d3e0-4c8d-b0f4-ce178afe7b87.description:
Having given up on his dreams and returned to his hometown, Keita reunites with his high school classmate, Tsubaki. Back then, Tsubaki would always whimsically mess with Keita while he quietly drew illustrations in the corner of the classroom… Between Keita, who failed to become a manga artist, and Tsubaki, who is burdened by her own circumstance—it's a serious attempt for this adult gal and geek to start their lives over for real!
___

972a325d-e8c6-4500-b596-01525f640076.title: How to Ride the Hero's Coattails
972a325d-e8c6-4500-b596-01525f640076.altTitle: How to Walk the Protagonist's Path of Flowers
972a325d-e8c6-4500-b596-01525f640076.description:
Life never goes according to plan—something I had yet to learn back then.
Because of a friend from my past life, I begrudgingly read a male-oriented fantasy harem novel… only to wake up as a character inside it: Kang Nahyun.

Special perks for reincarnators? Ha! As if.
I had no money, no connections, and nothing but a hardcore survival mode to keep me going.

But just before high school, I awakened into the “Sniper” position, earning myself a spot at the Awakener Academy!

And if I can’t be the protagonist, then I’ll just hitch a ride on the protagonist’s flowery path, right?

So I make it my plan to stick close to Na Yuhan, the real hero of the story, snag a few scraps of luck, and quietly bow out…

Except something feels off.
With every passing day, my steps are veering further and further from the plan…

The chaotic Academy life of sunshine-heroine(?) Kang Nahyun begins now!
“How to Walk the Protagonist's Path of Flowers” — coming your way!

676daa71-5211-4de8-9204-2023c69df80e.title: Ne Iut eul Saranghara
676daa71-5211-4de8-9204-2023c69df80e.description:
Shin Hyeon-Woo, a young man who moved into the perfect apartment Terrarium, was living a very satisfying life. 

Until the man who jumped from the rooftop yesterday jumped again at the exact same time today. And all the other residents are repeating the same behaviour as yesterday... 

Is this place repeating a day infinitely? Or is everyone acting out the same day on purpose? 

If so, why? Whatever the truth, he has to get out of this crazy apartment complex.

ad00b12d-7c28-4371-8459-1814bee092e9.title: World's Strongest Survivor
ad00b12d-7c28-4371-8459-1814bee092e9.description:
"It isn't the strongest who survives. The one who survives is the strongest."

After being discharged from the military, Jin Seowoon did nothing but play games like a loser. One day, he was invited to the world of "Cloyd Survival," which resembled a game he enjoyed.

In that world were masters of martial arts, kings from other worlds, and notorious killers...

It was a gathering of monsters that surpassed human imagination.

Jin Seowoon had just one objective — to survive and become one of the top ten.

37b88c85-20b9-4f35-a024-db2c62220564.title: Nabe ni Dangan wo Ukenagara
37b88c85-20b9-4f35-a024-db2c62220564.altTitle: Getting Shot on the Frying Pan
37b88c85-20b9-4f35-a024-db2c62220564.description: Meet Juntaro. A Japanese fishing addict who was born and raised in what is perceived to be one of the roughest parts of Japan. It is through his lens where you can experience various parts of the world, their culture, and of course their food. He particularly loves to visit countries and cities that are also believed to be highly dangerous due to his personal belief that they will absolutely have delicious food. Because this was intended for a Japanese audience, you will also get to witness various worldviews unique to Japan alongside it all. There's just one problem: He has extreme brainrot and views the world through a cute anime girl filter.
